words: G says go for the tests: if every T4.3 answer gets its intended mark, tag tests-v1.0 and go on as Part Two says.
part_two: The fresh set, before any baseline answer is scored: answers written by a model other than scorer one's, to every line, each with the mark it is meant to get; a model of another maker is the better choice; the writer sees the tests' text only. AG Opus checks it; scorer one marks it once.
interface: the maker's standard interface, at its defaults
